findings.title: The run_check child inherits operator credentials the deny-list does not name
findings.recommendation: Give each configured check an explicit env allow-list merged onto a minimal base (PATH/HOME/LANG/TMPDIR) and pass it to Open3.popen3 with unsetenv_others: true - one keyword on the normalized check plus one spawn option; failing that, widen ENV_NAMES/ENV_PATTERN to cover *_KEY, *_TOKEN, *_DSN, *_URL and unnamed TAMOZ_*. Add one test that exports a secret name outside the current pattern and asserts the child cannot see it.
findings.evidence: Reproduced by direct execution: with TAMOZ_DATABASE_PASSWORD and TAMOZ_SIGNING_KEY exported, the child printed ["TAMOZ_SIGNING_KEY"]. credential_free_env is a redaction list (nil values), not a scrubber, so every unmatched name is inherited verbatim into the child whose stdout becomes the check receipt, the model prompt, and the durable log (invariant 24).

findings.title: The staging sweep deletes user files that match the reserved name shape
findings.recommendation: Strengthen identity at the existing predicate: accept only Tempfile-produced names (\A\.tamoz-(?:create-)?\d{8}-\d+-[a-z0-9]+\.tmp\z, which both observed real stage names match) and require the owner-only mode the staging Tempfile is created with. Add the missing test: plant a .tamoz-notes.tmp regular file at the same age and assert it survives.
findings.evidence: Reproduced: a stale mode-0755 regular file named .tamoz-notes.tmp in a fresh workspace was deleted and reported in reaped_staging when Toolbox.new(root:, allow_changes: true) was constructed. Age + uid + name-shape is not provenance, and no test plants a pattern match that is not a staging file (every refusal test plants a near-miss).

findings.title: The sweep's MAX_FILES head can starve an orphan indefinitely
findings.recommendation: Drop the break at staging_reaper.rb:44 so MAX_FILES bounds deletions per session (which is what the existing test claims) rather than the candidate scan window.

findings.title: apply_patch publishes by rename onto a path with no lstat/fstat guard (intermediate-component TOCTOU)
findings.recommendation: Reuse the sibling defence: re-run the parent realpath equality check on path.dirname inside atomic_replace immediately before File.rename, exactly as CreationOperations#revalidate_parent does.

findings.title: The check ENV_PATTERN deny-list is a second, unbound secret taxonomy
findings.recommendation: Add one test asserting the property (representative operator secret names classify as credentials) so the env taxonomy and Core::SECRET_VALUE_PATTERNS cannot drift silently. Supporting evidence for F08-SEC-01; no independent production change.
